verified_facts.fact: OEWS May 2025 news release date 15 May 2026
OEWS May 2025 uses the 2018 SOC, about 830 categories in 22 of 23 major groups (major group 55 excluded)
Annual wages: where wage-rate data are lacking the annual rate is the hourly wage times a typical 2,080-hour year (BLS derivation)
Industry scope: 2022 NAICS; most agriculture and private households excluded; federal data cover only USPS and the executive branch; state and local government covered
Geography: nation, states, DC, Guam, Puerto Rico, US Virgin Islands, about 530 metropolitan and nonmetropolitan areas (national file only is authorised)

May 2025 estimates use a model-based MB3 method with three years of data; employment is the average of May 2025 and November 2024 QCEW; a funding lapse 1 Oct to 12 Nov 2025 caused delay without methodology change
Top-coded wage footnote: 'equal to or greater than $115.00 per hour or $239,200 per year'; from May 2025 BLS publishes specific estimates for many percentiles that previously carried the footnote
Unreleased estimates carry the footnote 'Estimate not released'
Public domain except previously copyrighted photographs and illustrations; citation of BLS requested; unauthorised use of the BLS emblem prohibited; commercial use not addressed
2018 SOC structure and definitions XLSX files exist at the SOC 2018 page; the page states no reuse terms and links the BLS copyright page
